packet_dag.terminal_condition: The packet is complete when member-library and classroom secure-link access opens directly, access-code entry is visibly fallback/support-only, current access persists between library and classroom, tests pass, and deploy/live smoke proves the production UI.

title: One Time Access Code And Session UX

reasons: The operator said logged-in parents/students should not feel like they are joining a classroom by code.
Current member-library and classroom pages auto-open when a code is present, but still present Access Code as the dominant first panel.
The safe implementation can improve the visible UX while preserving the existing access-code authorization contract.
likely_external_provider_blockers: A true password/session replacement for One Time member access requires a later backend/account mapping packet; this packet is a safe secure-link/fallback UX step.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this packet, only the Drive-to-Vimeo provider setup packet remains blocked by DEC-20260708-006.

operator_intent_summary: Make One Time parent/student/member access feel like opening the signed-in class/library experience from an invite or current session, not like joining a classroom by typing a code.
raw_quotes: we don't really need that I didn't really understand why you need to have a classroom code to join the classroom that's kind of irrelevant because anyone with the login has access to the classroom
Parent/student session or magic-link access opens library/classroom directly; any code field becomes fallback/support-only and not the primary classroom UX.
out_of_scope: No new parent password flow, student password flow, email send, magic-link send, payment mutation, external provider write, or access grant.
No removal of the existing access-code API until a true session-backed One Time member mapping is implemented and verified.
No raw access code display after a page is opened except inside the fallback input a user intentionally uses.
affected_surfaces: One Time member library access panel

inspection_targets: public/member-library.html access form, auto-load, localStorage, classroom link
public/one-time-classroom.html access form, auto-load, localStorage, response submission
observed: Parent trial invite links still use /member-library?code=... and /one-time-classroom?code=...
Both pages auto-open when a code is present in the URL or localStorage.
Both pages keep an Access Code panel visible as a primary hero/control even after access opens.
The current backend authorization contract is still access-code based for these routes.
known_blockers: A true no-code backend session bridge needs a later data mapping from parent/student/member session to one_time_member_access; this packet does not invent that mapping.

expanded_phrases.logged-in parent/student: The visible copy should describe secure One Time access, not a public classroom join flow.
expanded_phrases.join classroom by code: Do not lead with classroom-code language; the page should auto-open from a link/current access and present manual code entry as recovery/support.
expanded_phrases.fallback/support-only: Code entry remains available but is secondary, collapsible or visually subordinate, and clearly named fallback access.
expanded_phrases.mobile: The access/status panel must stay compact on 430px and 390px without wasted hero height or horizontal overflow.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use the existing first-party access-code API as the authorization primitive while presenting secure-link/current-access UX as primary.

requirements.statement: Make One Time member-library and classroom access feel like secure invite/current access, not joining by classroom code.
requirements.expected_result: When a code is already present from a link or stored current access, the library/classroom opens directly and shows active access status; manual code entry is labeled fallback/support-only.
acceptance_criteria: Access panel copy uses secure/current access language instead of primary classroom-code language.
Manual code entry is secondary and named fallback/support.
Library-to-classroom navigation preserves current access without forcing a new code entry.
Invalid/no access still has a clear recovery path and does not expose member data.
No backend access control is weakened.

criteria: RAW-20260708-006 and the July 8 register exist.
Current-state inspection confirmed the backend still requires access-code scoped member-library/classroom APIs.
This packet is limited to safe UX/copy/navigation improvements and does not claim a full password/session backend bridge.
Existing access-code denial behavior must remain intact.

loading.accessibility_expectation: Primary status and fallback control are keyboard reachable.

empty.accessibility_expectation: Fallback input is labeled and not color-only.

forbidden_content: join classroom by code as primary copy
populated.accessibility_expectation: Fallback details are reachable after content opens.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: Classroom auto-loads from query/localStorage and stores oneTimeClassroomCode.

filtered_empty.expected_visible_message: No published library items match this view.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Filters and fallback access do not collide.

success_readback.accessibility_expectation: UI can render member-safe payload without guessing.

findings.user_impact: The access panel still reads like a code-entry gate even when a secure link already opened the classroom.
findings.expected_fix: Make current/secure access primary and fallback code entry secondary.

requirements: Fallback access controls must have labels and visible status text.
Secure/current access status must be readable without relying on color.
Mobile layouts must avoid horizontal overflow and large wasted access panels after content opens.

action_states.label: Use fallback access code
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Fallback entry is for support/legacy links only; it does not grant access without a valid existing code.

must_not_add: raw access-code exposure outside fallback input
session-to-access mapping without verified backend source
new access grant or email send

privacy_invariants: Invalid/no access shows no member data.
Current UX must not bypass the existing API access checks.
Code entry remains a fallback and does not create a new entitlement.

instructions: Change access panel copy to current/secure access language.
Make manual code entry visually and semantically secondary.
Preserve query/localStorage auto-open and progress API code usage.
Change classroom access panel copy to current/secure access language.
Keep response submission using the current access value.
Preserve review mode and invalid-access behavior.
Update focused tests for fallback/support access copy and current-access navigation.
Run PQC validation, focused tests, browser smoke, protocol drift, secrets audit, and diff check.
Record evidence, commit, push, deploy, and live-smoke.
